name: Prospector Remtravel
summary: In southern Darkshore, Prospector Remtravel leads the Explorers' League dig among ancient relics. His scattered focus and the dangers around camp make the work perilous.

sections.title: A Dwarven Dig in Elven Lands
sections.body: The Explorers' League sent Prospector Remtravel across the sea to establish a dig in southern Darkshore. Night elves guard their ancestral lands, yet the League's search for Azeroth's origins brings its prospectors into forgotten places. Remtravel uncovers fossils and ancient stones. Aggressive wildlife and hostile local threats make the camp hard for one scatterbrained dwarf to manage.

sections.title: The Absent-Minded Scholar
sections.body: Prospector Remtravel loses himself in thought and research notes. When he wanders from camp in search of fossils or lost artifacts, predators and hostile creatures can corner him. Those who find Remtravel in the wild often must protect his fragile discoveries and rescue him from Darkshore's dangers.

aliases: who is the dwarf in darkshore
faq.answer: Prospector Remtravel is an archaeologist and surveyor from Ironforge, sent by the Explorers' League. He seeks ancient relics and fossils at his small excavation camp in southern Darkshore.

faq.q: Why is an Ironforge dwarf digging in Darkshore?
aliases: why is a dwarf in darkshore
what is the explorers league doing in darkshore
faq.answer: The Explorers' League searches the known world for titan artifacts, lost history, and ancient fossils. Darkshore's ruins and ties to the distant past draw dwarven scholars there.
Remtravel loses track of his surroundings and equipment when absorbed in scholarship. He often wanders into danger without noticing nearby predators and beasts.

faq.q: Is Prospector Remtravel related to anyone in the League?
faq.answer: Prospector Remtravel is believed to be the adventurous uncle Karna Remtravel mentions. She credits him with inspiring her passion for discovery and the wider world.

angles.text: As a dwarf, Remtravel shows the Explorers' League's resolve to piece together dwarven origins, even in Kalimdor's cold, damp woods.
As a night elf, you may find the League's noisy digging and disturbed ancient soils testing the patience of local sentinels and druids.
